from datetime import datetime

# Registration time
registered_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat('2022-04-03T10:27:47')

# Subscriptions (re-fetch to avoid hardcoding)
access_token='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJzcG90aWZ5K2dsZW5uLmJ1cnRvbkBnbWFpbC5jb20iLCJleHAiOjE2ODQ0MTIwOTh9.ZfYQhLH5HAUhTGeoP9Sil5Smkby8zvIfSpm2gzMvmWk'

acct=apis.spotify.show_account(access_token=access_token)
registered_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(acct['registered_at'])
now_dt = datetime.now()

all_subs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_premium_subscriptions(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_subs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1

# Parse and filter by overlap with [registered_at_dt, now_dt]
interval_paid=[]
for s in all_subs:
    start_dt=datetime.fromisoformat(s['start_date'])
    end_dt=datetime.fromisoformat(s['end_date'])
    paid=s['paid_amount']
    overlaps = end_dt >= registered_at_dt and start_dt <= now_dt
    if overlaps:
        interval_paid.append((s['premium_subscription_id'], start_dt, end_dt, paid))

sum_paid=sum(p[3] for p in interval_paid)

print('registered_at_dt',registered_at_dt)
print('now_dt',now_dt)
print('total_subs',len(all_subs))
print('subs_overlapping',len(interval_paid))
print('sum_paid',sum_paid)
print('first3',interval_paid[:3])
print('last3',interval_paid[-3:])

from datetime import datetime

# Login again to get fresh token and ensure no assumptions about previous variables.
spotify_pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()[6]['password']
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='glenn.burton@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']
acct = apis.spotify.show_account(access_token=access_token)
registered_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(acct['registered_at'])
now_dt = datetime.now()

# Fetch all premium subscriptions (paginate)
all_subs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_premium_subscriptions(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_subs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

# Compute sums using two reasonable interpretations for 'since I made the spotify account'
# 1) Overlap with [registered_at_dt, now_dt]
# 2) Subscription start >= registered_at_dt and start <= now_dt
sum_overlap = 0.0
sum_start = 0.0
subs_start_before=[]
for s in all_subs:
    start_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(s['start_date'])
    end_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(s['end_date'])
    paid = float(s['paid_amount'])

    if end_dt >= registered_at_dt and start_dt <= now_dt:
        sum_overlap += paid

    if start_dt < registered_at_dt:
        subs_start_before.append(s['premium_subscription_id'])

    if start_dt >= registered_at_dt and start_dt <= now_dt:
        sum_start += paid

print('registered_at_dt', registered_at_dt)
print('now_dt', now_dt)
print('total_subs', len(all_subs))
print('subs_start_before_registered_at', len(subs_start_before), subs_start_before[:10])
print('sum_overlap', sum_overlap)
print('sum_start', sum_start)
